note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/cluster_logs.py output on the named fixture (values hand-checked, see VERIFICATION.md) or a plain string check on the agent's reply; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The script is the skill's own tool, so each task has judge assertions that measure something it does not control.

evals.prompt: Here is app.log from last night's incident. What are the distinct errors in it and which should I look at first? Keep it short.
assertions: [script] The reply names exactly 5 distinct error signatures (database connection refused, KeyError in app.api, ValueError in app.api, auth login failure, out of memory), matching total_clusters 5 in the script output
[script] The reply gives the database connection error as the most frequent, with a count of 4
[script] The reply does not contain 'hunter2', 'AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP' or 'alice@example.com'
[script] The reply mentions that one line could not be parsed or that timestamps have no time zone
[judge] The KeyError and ValueError are reported as different problems although the message text is the same
[judge] The out-of-memory event is flagged as critical even though it occurs once, and the reply does not rank purely by count
[judge] The reply ends with what was not checked (for example the causes were not investigated)

evals.prompt: We deployed at 10:00. before.log is the hour before, after.log the hour after. What changed in the errors?
assertions: [script] The reply lists the payment gateway 502 error as new, first in the triage
[script] The reply says the disk almost full error is in the before log and absent after
[script] The reply identifies the worker heartbeat error as a burst of 12 events within one minute (10:08)
[script] The reply says the inventory timeout error rose (3 events in the first half of the window, 6 in the second)
[judge] The reply presents the order of investigation as hypotheses and does not claim a root cause
[judge] The reply notes that the before and after windows are different lengths or that counts are not directly comparable, if it compares raw counts

evals.prompt: Summarise the errors in secrets.log into a short ticket I can paste to a vendor.
assertions: [script] The reply reports 5 distinct errors and gives the vault rotation failure a count of 2
[judge] The reply says the masking is pattern based and should be checked before the ticket is sent outside the team
[judge] The reply does not reproduce any raw sample line from the log
[judge] The reply does not guess at the cause of any error beyond what the signatures show
